'''An Urgent Task and the Capture of an Ultra Beast''' (Japanese: '''急務！！UB捕獲戦！''' ''Urgent!! The Battle to Capture the Ultra Beasts!'') is the 20th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
* {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} tell {{adv|Looker}} and [[Anabel]] about the [[Ultra Beast]]s in [[Alola]].
* Looker heads off to gather information about the Ultra Beasts.
* Anabel and Sun battle a {{p|Blacephalon}} that appeared from an [[Ultra Wormhole]] and try to catch it, but fail.
* {{p|Tapu Bulu}} appears and {{m|Whirlwind|blows Blacephalon away}}, rescuing everyone from it.
* Sun and Moon give Tapu Bulu the [[Mirage Berry]].
* Anabel decides to look for [[Colress|the person]] who can make [[Beast Ball|Poké Balls capable of capturing Ultra Beasts]].
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
